movelist.name: Attract
movelist.effect: Attract Infatuates the target if its gender is the opposite of the user’s. Attract fails when used by or against Genderless targets.

movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Sing
movelist.effect: All legal Targets fall Asleep. On a miss, Sing instead causes targets to become Slowed and suffer a -2 penalty to their Evasion until the end of the user’s next turn.

movelist.name: Foresight
movelist.effect: Foresight may be activated as a Swift Action on the user’s turn. For the rest of the turn, the user’s Normal-Type and Fighting-Type Moves can hit and affect Ghost-Type targets, and the user can see through the Illusion Ability, Moves with the Illusion keyword, and effects created by the Illusionist Capability, ignoring all effects from those.

abilities.name: Wonder Skin
abilities.effect: The user gains +6 Evasion against Status Moves. Defensive.

abilities.name: Normalize
abilities.effect: The user’s attacks cannot deal Super-Effective or Resisted Damage; they instead resolve as if dealing Neutral Damage. The user also takes neutral damage from all attacks to which they are not immune. This does not affect Immunities.
